question: Does the already frozen generic bisection atlas contain several sections over the same quadratic parameter field, providing a possible block under one rational square condition?
selection: All 39119 finite-chart equations in rank_jump_solubility_first_geometry_v1.json.gz; the previously excluded inverted chart remains outside this audit.
method: Normalize each squarefree quadratic up to rational scalar by primitive signed integer coefficients. Only within equal branch-polynomial groups test the scalar ratio for being a rational square. Distinct squareclasses mean different quadratic function fields. A repeated field is only a candidate block; independence of its sections modulo the marked MW17 subgroup requires a separate certificate.
failure_semantics: Nonsquarefree equations are reported separately rather than assigned the quadratic-branch argument. No duplicate field excludes a common-cover block among these displayed sections only, not hidden additional sections on a twist.
boundary: Input contains generic geometry and no exceptional points, ranks, or parameters. This is an incidence audit of possible common-field section groups, not a validated high-rank selector.
